global_rules: Substantial jobs; atomic steps inside jobs
Read actual source and current branch before writes
Only assigned isolated candidate branches and paths
One immutable receipt per completed job
Auto-next only within actual session/tool authority
No publication, merge, DNS, credentials, payments or shared master mutation
HOLD only blocked transition; continue unrelated safe work
No ACK or custody claim without readback

job_sequence: Inspect exact sources and record input revisions
Implement substantial isolated candidate with tests and receipt
Independent falsification, fix and successor checkpoint
